scenes.text: What if time stopped - but only for you?
scenes.art_prompt: a sun like an enormous glowing sphere beside a tiny Earth for scale, dramatic

scenes.text: Everyone would freeze mid-step. The world would hold its breath.
scenes.art_prompt: a person standing inside a transparent physics diagram of spacetime, glowing grid

scenes.text: You could walk anywhere. Move anything.
scenes.art_prompt: Earth splitting into bands of light as a hypothetical force passes through it

scenes.text: But light is carried by time. Without it, you would see nothing at all.
scenes.art_prompt: a clock melting into orbiting rings of numbers, surreal physics illustration

scenes.text: You would be awake, alone, in perfect darkness, forever.
scenes.art_prompt: light rays bending around a massive object, cosmic lensing diagram in space

scenes.text: Follow What If Physics for more.
scenes.art_prompt: a calm Earth from orbit with a subtle glowing field around it, resolved conclusion
